FREERADIUS_AUTO_LIMIT_ACCT.description: Automatically limit the number of accounting requests if the queue is full.

FREERADIUS_CLEANUP_DELAY.description: The time to wait (in seconds) before cleaning up a sent reply.

FREERADIUS_EXEC_PREFIX.description: The executable prefix directory, typically same as prefix.

FREERADIUS_GROUP.description: The group ID to run the radiusd server as.

FREERADIUS_HOSTNAME_LOOKUPS.description: Whether to log client names instead of just IP addresses (yes/no).

FREERADIUS_LIBDIR.description: The directory where rlm_* modules are located.

FREERADIUS_LIMIT_PROXY_STATE.description: Global setting for limiting Proxy-State and Message-Authenticator combination (no/yes/auto).

FREERADIUS_LOCALSTATEDIR.description: The local state directory for runtime files and logs.

FREERADIUS_LOGDIR.description: The directory where FreeRADIUS stores its log files.

FREERADIUS_LOG_AUTH.description: Log all authentication results (accept and reject) to the log file.

FREERADIUS_LOG_AUTH_BADPASS.description: Log passwords if they are rejected.

FREERADIUS_LOG_AUTH_GOODPASS.description: Log passwords if they are correct.

FREERADIUS_LOG_COLOURISE.description: Highlight important messages sent to stderr and stdout.

FREERADIUS_LOG_DESTINATION.description: Destination for log messages: files, syslog, stdout, or stderr.

FREERADIUS_LOG_STRIPPED_NAMES.description: Log the full User-Name attribute including suffix (no=yes).

FREERADIUS_LOG_SYSLOG_FACILITY.description: Which syslog facility to use if destination is syslog.

FREERADIUS_MAX_ATTRIBUTES.description: The maximum number of attributes permitted in a RADIUS packet.

FREERADIUS_MAX_REQUESTS.description: The maximum number of requests the server keeps track of.

FREERADIUS_MAX_REQUEST_TIME.description: The maximum time (in seconds) to handle a request before killing it.

FREERADIUS_NAME.description: The name of the running server instance.

FREERADIUS_PREFIX.description: The installation prefix directory for FreeRADIUS.

FREERADIUS_PROXY_REQUESTS.description: Turns proxying of RADIUS requests on or off.

FREERADIUS_RADDDBDIR.description: The directory containing the FreeRADIUS configuration files (raddb).

FREERADIUS_REJECT_DELAY.description: Delay in seconds when sending an Access-Reject.

FREERADIUS_REQUIRE_MESSAGE_AUTHENTICATOR.description: Global setting for requiring Message-Authenticator in Access-* packets (no/yes/auto).

FREERADIUS_STATUS_SERVER.description: Whether the server responds to Status-Server requests.

FREERADIUS_THREAD_POOL_MAX_REQUESTS_PER_.description: Clean up old threads after this many requests. 0 means infinity.

FREERADIUS_THREAD_POOL_MAX_SERVERS.description: Limit on the total number of servers running in the thread pool.

FREERADIUS_THREAD_POOL_MAX_SPARE_SERVERS.description: Maximum number of spare servers in the thread pool.

FREERADIUS_THREAD_POOL_MIN_SPARE_SERVERS.description: Minimum number of spare servers in the thread pool.

FREERADIUS_THREAD_POOL_START_SERVERS.description: Number of servers to start initially in the thread pool.

FREERADIUS_USER.description: The user ID to run the radiusd server as.
